Notice of Delisting or Failure to Satisfy a Continued Listing Rule or Standard; Transfer of Listing. On August 22, 2023, the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) notified WeWork Inc. (the “Company”), and publicly announced, that the NYSE has determined to (A) commence proceedings to delist the Company’s warrant s, each whole warrant exercisable to purchase one share of the Company’s Class A common stock, par value $0.0001 per share (the “Common Stock”), at a price of $11.50 per share, and listed to trade on the NYSE under the symbol “WE WS” (the “Warrants”) and (B) immediately suspend trading in the Warrants due to “abnormally low” trading price levels pursuant to Section 802.01D of the NYSE Listed Company Manual. The Company does not intend to appeal the NYSE’s determination. Trading in the Company’s Common Stock will continue on the NYSE under the symbol “WE”.
